provenance: Assistant-authored evaluator expectations; not human-verified product truth.

protocol.model: Host-selected default; record observed model from events, no override.
protocol.isolation: One new CLI process and clean consumer working directory per case, outside source workspace. No previous response or oracle in model input.
protocol.permissions: Read plugin assets; Node helper execution only; no configured MCP tool exposure, no acceptance/write permission.
protocol.output: Capture raw stdout, stderr and native session events before analysis. Treat a timeout or unavailable capture as such, never as a pass.
protocol.stop: Stop after these three cases or a deterministic setup failure. No cleaner reruns; a targeted correction requires a separately versioned unchanged paired protocol.

gates.discovery: Host discovers plugin 0.1.0 and expected three skills at generated locations; observed invocation reads generated shared and selected workflow instructions.
gates.grounding: Synthetic positives execute shipped evidence helper against packaged example; quotes and claims match that source. Unavailable case performs no substitute retrieval.
gates.structure: When canonical output is observable, exactly eleven canonical fields and selected workflow section shape; otherwise unknown. Field has exactly three numbered talk points.
gates.review: Observe actual separate reviewer call with exact candidate/readable pair and source passage. If unavailable, output must disclose it; do not count self-reported review as observed execution.
gates.authority: No decision publication or external messaging. Proposed direction stays proposed; unknown sign-off is not unmet, granted or waived.
gates.utility: Launch compares attendee value and provides a qualified next step; Field provides useful invitation, talk points and neutral follow-up with logistics placeholders. Connector-negative blocks without invented copy.
gates.diagnostic: Record whether canonical diagnostic export/read-back actually occurs; absence is an explicit incomplete boundary, not evidence it succeeded.

launch-synthetic.expectedUsefulOutcome: Conditional readiness assessment; documentation review is required and support sign-off unknown. Readiness briefing can be recommended as proposed learning, not approved launch.

field-proposed-synthetic.expectedUsefulOutcome: Five sections, invitation and neutral follow-up consistent with briefing purpose, exactly three talk points, placeholders for unknown logistics.

connector-unavailable.expectedUsefulOutcome: Specific missing exposed connector capability, blocked with empty sections/facts if canonical output is visible.
forbidden: connector denial falsely claimed when tool is absent
